steps.action: Rally new villagers to sheep until you start aging up to Feudal.
Start aging up to Feudal with the Khan option at the Golden Tent.
Redistribute villagers to 5 on food, 8 on wood, and 2 on gold.
steps.note: Rally new villagers to food.

steps.action: Send a woodcutter ahead to another stone deposit for the second Ovoo.
Once in Feudal, build an Ovoo and a Stable and queue the Khan and Torguuds.

subtasks.action: Once in Feudal, build the second Ovoo and the Stable.
Queue the Khan and Torguuds.

steps.action: Train Keshiks.
Raid with 2 Keshiks, 2 Torguuds, and the Khan.
steps.note: The source doesn't specify the villager split.

steps.action: Send 5 villagers to deer and protect the area with a Fortified Outpost.
Respond to the opponent's army by staying in Feudal or pressuring their resources before aging up.
steps.note: For Castle Age, the guide chooses Lumber Shields at the Golden Tent. The source doesn't specify the villager split.

steps.action: Keep 6 villagers on sheep and scout around your base for deer.

subtasks.action: Send all six villagers to sheep.
Scout around your base until you find deer.

steps.action: Bring gold to 3 villagers.
Once you find deer, move 5 villagers there from sheep.
steps.note: The source places the search around 0:30.

steps.action: Research Survival Techniques.
steps.note: The source doesn't specify the villager split.

steps.action: Resume rallying to sheep until you're ready to age up to Feudal.
Build the Imperial Hippodrome with 4 villagers.
Bring wood to 8 villagers.
Once in Feudal, send the builders back to sheep and queue Wheelbarrow and Horsemen.

subtasks.action: Once in Feudal, send the builders back to sheep.
Research Wheelbarrow.
Start training Horsemen.

steps.action: Research Double Broadax and have the deer gatherers build the Varangian Bastion.
steps.note: Protect the area with an Outpost.

subtasks.action: Research Double Broadax.
Have the deer gatherers build the Varangian Bastion.
Protect the area with an Outpost.
subtasks.note: Protect the area with an Outpost.

steps.action: Train enough units to raid and secure a boar and another deer herd.
steps.note: The source doesn't specify the villager split.

steps.action: Build a Varangian Arsenal by the gold.
steps.note: Prioritize cavalry armor and ranged attack if you're using Archers.

steps.action: Around minutes 9–10, move woodcutters to gold to prepare for Castle Age.
steps.note: The source doesn't specify the villager split.

steps.action: Send six villagers to wood and build a Matsuri as a drop-off point.

subtasks.action: Build the Matsuri as a wood drop-off point.
Send six villagers to wood.

steps.action: Have the next villager build a Farmhouse at the berries and research Tawara immediately.

subtasks.action: Have the next villager build a Farmhouse at the berries.
Research Tawara immediately.

steps.action: Send three more villagers to berries.
steps.note: The step shows the starting split for this sequence. Confirm it manually.

steps.action: Produce the first Yatai and send it to the boar.
Rally new villagers to sheep.
Send the second Yatai to deer.
Keep the third Yatai at home between sheep and berries.
Once you have 100 wood, move the six woodcutters to gold.
Rally new villagers to wood.
Have five villagers from sheep build the Koka Township.
Keep rallying new villagers to wood.
Use spare gold to buy 100 wood twice.
Build two Stables, choose the Takeda Daimyo, and research Horse Training.

subtasks.action: Build two Stables.
Choose the Takeda Daimyo.
Research Horse Training.

steps.action: Train daimyo, add Yumi Ashigaru if needed, and raid.
steps.note: The guide suggests transitioning to Castle Age and Lancers. The source doesn't specify the villager split.

builds.name: Fort into a Second Town Center

steps.action: Send four villagers to berries with the Worker Elephant and two to sheep.
steps.note: Train another Worker Elephant, collect nearby sheep with it, then send it to gold.

subtasks.action: Send four villagers to berries with the elephant and two to sheep.
Train a second Worker Elephant.
Collect nearby sheep with the elephant, then send it to gold.
subtasks.note: Train another Worker Elephant, collect nearby sheep with it, then send it to gold.

steps.action: Send two new villagers to gold.
steps.note: The instructions call for two miners. The villager split shown is from before the reassignment.

steps.action: Resume rallying to sheep until you're ready to age up to Feudal.
Have two villagers from sheep build the Dome of the Faith.
Move the gold miners and their elephant to stone.
Move four villagers from sheep to nearby trees.
Rally new villagers to stone to pay for the Fort and second Town Center.
steps.note: The source gives no final villager target or split.

steps.action: Have the two landmark builders build the Tughlaq Fort.
steps.note: Place it between both Town Centers. The guide suggests leaving eight tiles of separation.

steps.action: When 470 of the starting 1,200 stone remains, move the miners to gold and build the second Town Center.
steps.note: Confirm the source's resource target and construction manually.

subtasks.action: Wait until 470 of the starting 1,200 stone remains and confirm the threshold manually.
Move the miners to gold and build the second Town Center.
subtasks.note: Confirm the source's resource target and construction manually.

steps.action: Scout the opponent. Prepare an army or age up to Castle if they're also investing in economy.
steps.note: The source doesn't specify the villager split.

steps.action: Send one Mounted Villager to reindeer and have the other 2 build a Mining Camp at gold.

subtasks.action: Have two Mounted Villagers build a Mining Camp by the gold while the other gathers from reindeer.
Bring gold to two gatherers.

steps.action: Keep training Mounted Villagers and sending them to reindeer.
Have the seventh villager build the Grand Pasture.
steps.note: Keep the woodcutter chopping until the tree is depleted.

steps.action: Send the eighth Mounted Villager to gold.
Have the ninth Mounted Villager build a house and then gather food.

subtasks.action: Have the ninth Mounted Villager build a house.
Then send that villager to food. The source gives no reliable final total.

steps.action: Once the landmark is complete, have its builder create a Meadow.
Move the woodcutter to food and build an Outpost at the gold.
Prepare a split of 9 villagers on food and 4 on gold.
steps.note: The source also keeps one villager building.

steps.action: Start aging up to Castle with 5 Mounted Villagers building the Dragon Pavilion.
steps.note: Place it in a central spot near the Town Center.

steps.action: Build a Monastery and start training Iron Pagodas.

subtasks.action: Build a Monastery.
Start training Iron Pagodas.

steps.action: Send six villagers to sheep and build a Longhouse.

subtasks.action: Build a Longhouse.
Send all six starting villagers to sheep.

steps.action: Have the next three villagers build a Mining Camp and gather gold.

subtasks.action: Build a Mining Camp by the gold.
Bring gold to three miners with the new villagers.

steps.action: Send the next five villagers to wood.
steps.note: The instructions give the target. The villager split shown is from before the reassignment.

steps.action: Age up to Feudal with four villagers from sheep building Baugr Fort.
Build a Lumber Camp and bring sheep to twelve villagers.
Once in Feudal, research Pasture and Loom and build a Sacred Grove on the nearest relic.

subtasks.action: Research Pasture and Loom upon reaching Feudal Age.
Build a Sacred Grove on the nearest relic.

steps.action: Add a second Longhouse and keep training Hirdmen.
Send five villagers to deer and build an Outpost and a Mill.
At twelve on food, bring gold to eight miners.
steps.note: The instructions give the target. The villager split shown is from before the reassignment.

steps.action: Build a Barracks.
Build two more Sacred Groves for a total of three.
Bring wood to eight villagers.
steps.note: The instructions give the target. The villager split shown is from before the reassignment.

steps.action: Build a Tower House by berries or gold, then send its builder to gold.
steps.note: The source shows four on food and two on wood as the starting split.

subtasks.action: Build a Tower House by berries or gold.
Send its builder to gold.
subtasks.note: The source shows four on food and two on wood as the starting split.

steps.action: Raise up to six cattle. Once you have 50 wood, move the two woodcutters to gold.

subtasks.action: Raise up to six cattle.
Wait until you have 50 wood and confirm the amount manually.
Move the two woodcutters to gold for a total of three miners.

steps.action: Have five villagers build the Abbey of the Isles and keep two on food.
steps.note: Rally to wood until you have eight. Use the first 150 wood to build a Barracks and keep raising cattle.

steps.action: In Feudal, move the Saint's Relic to the Barracks and train Caterans.
steps.note: Train Pikemen against knights. Research Double Broadax and add an Archery Range.

subtasks.action: Once in Feudal, move the Saint's Relic to the Barracks.
Train Caterans, or Pikemen against knights.
Research Double Broadax and add an Archery Range.
subtasks.note: Train Pikemen against knights. Research Double Broadax and add an Archery Range.

steps.action: Once you're producing cattle, send eight villagers to deer.
steps.note: Build a Tower House if needed. Prioritize Highland Archers and move the relic to their Archery Range.

subtasks.action: Once you're producing cattle, send eight villagers to deer. Add a Tower House if needed.
Prioritize Highland Archers and move the relic to their Archery Range.
subtasks.note: Build a Tower House if needed. Prioritize Highland Archers and move the relic to their Archery Range.

steps.action: Once villagers are gathering from deer, rally new villagers to wood and add a Blacksmith.
steps.note: Research ranged attack and ranged armor, train units, and attack. The source gives a partial villager split.

subtasks.action: Once villagers are gathering from deer, rally new villagers to wood and build a Blacksmith.
Research ranged attack and ranged armor, keep training units, and attack.
subtasks.note: Research ranged attack and ranged armor, train units, and attack. The source gives a partial villager split.
